facts.fact: The Direction Générale des Impôts guide describes online enrolment in its tele-declaration and tele-payment system, through which taxpayers or mandated professionals liquidate and file returns.
facts.system: système de la télé-déclaration et du télé-paiement

facts.fact: The same guide says taxpayers or their mandated professionals pay their declarations through the tele-payment system, using bank or postal account direct-debit authorisations.
facts.system: système de la télé-déclaration et du télé-paiement
